prompt:
In triangles $ABC$ and $XYZ$, $AB = 22$, $XY = 11$, and angles $A$ and $X$ both measure $77^{\circ}$. Which of the following pieces of information, if any, would be enough to prove that the two triangles are similar to each other?

I. Angle $B$ measures $40^{\circ}$

II. Angle $Y$ measures $50^{\circ}$

III. Angle $Z$ measures $63^{\circ}$

choices.text: Angle measures alone do not provide enough information.
I and II together provide enough information.
I and III together provide enough information.
